summary: The agent ignored the existing compute_spc.py script and wrote custom code that produced invalid p-values (exactly 0.0), which the skill explicitly flags as computation errors. This patch strengthens the skill by: (1) making script usage more prominent and imperative, (2) adding explicit p-value validation with correction guidance, and (3) updating the script to detect and correct p-values that are exactly 0.0 or 1.0.
